# Historical weapon fixture

These profiles preserve the pre-IFV export, with Scene32 / NativeWeapons1
headers for the historical laser-graph regression. They were captured before
Scene34 was implemented; their SourceSHA256 fields identify the installed
original rules. The test does not down-convert the current catalog, whose
negative repair weapons cannot be represented by version 1.

The current profile and cell-order behavior are tested separately.
